components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Enabled catalog action. Gradient at rest; flat on hover and pressed.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; min-width: 44px; padding: 10px 50px; border: none; border-radius: 20px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #005EAA, #3470E8); color: #FFFFFF; font-family: "Public Sans", sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #00569B; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #004379; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #005EAA; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #B0CDE5; color: #FFFFFF; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined action. Wash at rest; hollow on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; min-width: 44px; padding: 10px 30px; border: 1px solid #005EAA; border-radius: 20px; background: rgba(0, 94, 170, 0.1); color: #005EAA; font-family: "Public Sans", sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: transparent; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: transparent; border-color: #004379; color: #004379; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #005EAA; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { background: rgba(176, 205, 229, 0.2); border-color: #B0CDE5; color: #8AB5D8; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Tertiary Button

components.html: <button class="ds-btn-tertiary">Learn more <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M6 3.5L10.5 8L6 12.5" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-tertiary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 44px; min-width: 44px; padding: 0; border: none; background: transparent; color: #005EAA; font-family: "Public Sans", sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-tertiary:hover { color: #00569B; } .ds-btn-tertiary:active { color: #004379; } .ds-btn-tertiary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #005EAA; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.html:

A catalog card for one continuing-education program.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFFFF; color: #232529; border-radius: 12px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 2px 2px 0 #E5E7EB80; transition: box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 4px 0 #E5E7EB80; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0 0 8px; font-family: "Plus Jakarta Sans", sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 22px; letter-spacing: 0; } .ds-card-body { margin: 0; font-family: "Plus Jakarta Sans", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 20px; letter-spacing: 0; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Idle filter. Hover draws a signal-blue border; selected fills solid.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 30px; padding: 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: #666666; font-family: "Plus Jakarta Sans", sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 16px; letter-spacing: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: #005EAA; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #005EAA; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"], .ds-chip.is-selected { background: #005EAA; border-color: transparent; color: #FFFFFF; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Paper field with a signal-blue focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-family: "Plus Jakarta Sans", sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { color: #232529; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 18px; } .ds-input { height: 36px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #DFDFDF; border-radius: 6px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #232529; font-family: "Plus Jakarta Sans", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 20px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #767676; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #005EAA; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.description: Fixed white bar. Active link is signal blue.
components.html: MDCProgramsCalendar

components.css: .ds-sticky { display: inline-flex; padding: 5px; border-radius: 15px; background: rgba(154, 205, 254, 0.3); box-shadow: 0 4px 4px 0 #E5E7EB80; backdrop-filter: blur(5px); } .ds-sticky-card { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 25px; padding: 15px 20px; border-radius: 10px; background: #FBFBFB; border: 0.5px solid #E5E7EB; backdrop-filter: blur(5px); } .ds-sticky-label { font-family: "Plus Jakarta Sans", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 20px; color: #222222; } .ds-sticky-icon { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 15px; background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E5E7EB; cursor: pointer; } .ds-sticky-icon:hover { background: #FBFBFB; } .ds-sticky-icon:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #005EAA; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
The public site is a campus catalog. A program is a card on a strict grid, and a landing is a sequence of those modules. Type does the inviting: headlines are large, tightly leaded, and set with room around them. Color is measured. The page should feel like an editorial course listing, not a dashboard and not a campaign poster.

MDC Signal Blue carries buttons, links, and focus. Highlighter Yellow is not a general accent. It appears only on summer-camp surfaces. Everything else stays on paper white, soft grey, and Campus Ink. Cards rest on a short grey shadow and lift one step on hover. A blue shadow is emphasis, not the default.

This system is the public site under `.site-theme`. Caxton admin chrome keeps Lato and Archivo and stays outside it.
keyCharacteristics: Cards are the catalog module: white, 12px corners, Elevation 1 at rest
Headlines lock line-height to the font size; letter-spacing stays at 0
Signal blue does the actions; yellow is reserved for summer camps
Radii change with the job: 12px cards, 20px buttons, 10px chips, 25px icon frames
Every control keeps a 44×44px hit area

rules.name: The Summer Camp Rule
rules.body: Highlighter Yellow appears only on summer-camp surfaces. It is not a badge, button, link, or progress fill on any other program.

rules.name: The Token Rule
rules.body: Components use semantic color tokens. Raw palette classes and hardcoded hex in class names are out.

rules.name: The Locked Leading Rule
rules.body: Display and headline line-height equal the font size. Letter-spacing stays at 0.

rules.name: The Two Faces Rule
rules.body: Plus Jakarta Sans sets the page. Public Sans sets action labels.

rules.name: The Opening Margin Rule
rules.body: Gutters stay 20px. Page margin stays 20px through tablet, then 60px at 1132px and 120px at 1468px.

rules.name: The Short Shadow Rule
rules.body: Cards rest on Elevation 1. Hover and the sticky bar use Elevation 2. The blue shadow is for emphasis only.

rules.name: The Role Radius Rule
rules.body: Radius follows the component. Cards 12px, buttons 20px, chips 10px, framed icons 25px, sticky shell 15px.

rules.name: The 44 Rule
rules.body: Every button, including icon, header, and sticky-bar actions, has a minimum hit area of 44×44px.

dos: **Do** treat a landing as a sequence of catalog cards on the 4 / 8 / 12 grid.
**Do** use semantic color tokens for every fill, border, and text color.
**Do** keep Highlighter Yellow on summer-camp surfaces only.
**Do** set page type in Plus Jakarta Sans and action labels in Public Sans.
**Do** give every button a 44×44px hit area, even when the painted box is shorter.
**Do** rest cards on Elevation 1 and lift them to Elevation 2 on hover.
donts: **Don't** use Tailwind palette classes or hex colors in class names.
**Don't** use Highlighter Yellow for badges, buttons, links, or progress on non-camp programs.
**Don't** apply this system to Caxton admin chrome. Admin keeps Lato and Archivo.
**Don't** fade text with opacity. Use muted text for secondary copy.
**Don't** leave the primary-button gradient on hover or pressed. Those states are flat.
**Don't** share one corner radius across cards, buttons, chips, and icon frames.
